title: Burford contributes insights on fertilizer disputes to Corporate Counsel
summary: In an article for Corporate Counsel, Greg McPolin and Christiane Deniger examine how geopolitical tensions and market concentration are creating litigation and arbitration risks across global supply chains. Commenting on developments in the fertilizer industry, they examine the potential for force majeure, contractual and antitrust claims stemming from supply disruptions, rising costs and alleged anticompetitive conduct. Learn more.
body_markdown:
In an article for *Corporate Counsel* ,[Christiane Deniger](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christiane-deniger/) and Greg McPolin examine how geopolitical tensions and market concentration are creating litigation and arbitration risks across global supply chains. Commenting on developments in the fertilizer industry, they examine the potential for force majeure, contractual and antitrust claims stemming from supply disruptions, rising costs and alleged anticompetitive conduct.


Download the article above.
